set-fog-view-distance.name: Set Fog View Distance
set-fog-view-distance.description:
Set a custom view distance for the skybox fog.

Higher numbers mean bluer skies.

fix-skybox-clipping.name: Fix Skybox Clipping
fix-skybox-clipping.description: Fixes skybox clipping on low render distances by increasing far plane clipping.

lower-sky-void-darkness.name: Lower Sky Void Darkness
lower-sky-void-darkness.description:
Correctly lowers the height when the sky turns black to the world's lowest height.

This prevents the sky from suddenly turning black at a high Y value, and should now smoothly fade to black instead.

Most noticeable in Skyblock or void type worlds.

remove-sunrise-and-sunset-coloring.name: Remove Sunrise and Sunset Coloring
remove-sunrise-and-sunset-coloring.description: Removes the colored ring during sunrise and sunset, preventing the harsh fog discoloration effect.

remove-void-box.name: Remove Void Box
remove-void-box.description: Removes the black box that renders around the player in the void.

remove-sky-in-void.name: Remove Sky in the Void
remove-sky-in-void.description: Removes the sky when in the void. This fixes MC-249655.

clear-skies.name: Clear Skies
clear-skies.description:
Removes banding on the horizon, making the sky one uniform color.

This is taken from grondag's Clear Skies mod.
